selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out look-alikes like chamomile or aster based on fine-grained features.
To check for subtle AI artifacts such as 'melting' petal tips, inconsistent lighting, or unnatural texture repetition in the white petals.
To ensure the boundary between the yellow disc and white petals is sharp and physically coherent, checking for edge bleeding common in AI generation.

focus_areas: Texture consistency of the yellow disc florets
Edge sharpness between petals and background
Natural variation in petal shape and length
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the yellow center and white petals. AI often blurs this boundary or creates a 'halo' effect. Also, inspect the tips of the white petals for any signs of dissolution into the background bokeh.
